methodology: Directly downloaded official council documents, identified by PDF signature and read with pypdf 6.21.2 from the official py-pdf/pypdf release. Search results were discovery leads only. PDF page numbers below are physical PDF pages, not necessarily printed pagination. Reports are budget-setting documents or annual budget publications, not audited outturn accounts. Separate appendices are not exhaustively archived. Local figures retain their own accounting definitions and are NOT reconciled to MHCLG RA net service expenditure or revenue expenditure; they must not be used in the common RA ranking. A Council agenda report proves the document considered, not that every recommendation survived amendment; adoption/decision context is distinguished in individual notes. Bromley is a summary-publication fallback, not a retrieved full technical report.
